pages.title: One Shot Duel Snipe Hide
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: One Shot Duel Snipe Hide combines shooting challenges with hiding and pursuit. Move into position, use cover, and fire at opponents during the encounters. A separate Subway Escape mode adds movement controls for crouching and jumping alongside aiming, reloading, and throwing bombs.

pages.title: Scrap Car Merge
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Scrap Car Merge sends your armed car along roads filled with opponents. Shoot enemy vehicles, survive their attacks, and reach the finish to earn rewards. Spend your coins on parts and stronger weapons between runs to improve the car for the next battle.

pages.title: Wacky Strike
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Wacky Strike lets you choose a side in a battle between boys and girls. Build up your base, recruit troops, and push across the battlefield toward the enemy castle. Towers, different units, and powerups give you choices for attacking and defending.

pages.title: Remove The Blocks
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Remove The Blocks challenges you to dismantle three dimensional formations. Click a block to slide it out in the direction it faces, first checking that other pieces will not obstruct it. Clear the entire structure, with your completion time affecting the score.

pages.title: Escape Again
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Escape Again takes you through a drawn world filled with obstacles and traps. Guide the character around each area and find the magical pins needed to activate its portal. Reaching that portal lets you continue the journey in the next level.

pages.title: Shark Chomp Chase
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Shark Chomp Chase has you guide a shark around the water eating fish to grow. Your shark's size determines which prey it can swallow, while dangerous creatures threaten the hunt. Find suitable food and build up enough growth to tackle larger targets.

pages.title: Sand Blast - Block Game
pages.creator: FunFox Games
pages.description: Sand Blast - Block Game turns placed shapes into flowing colored sand. Drag the offered blocks onto the board and create complete rows of one color to clear them. Manage the remaining space while setting up repeated clears and larger scoring combinations.

pages.title: Monster School Challenge
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Monster School Challenge puts a class of characters through their teacher's tests. Throw a bottle with a carefully judged swipe, time jumps and stops, and clear obstacles in later tasks. Each assignment changes what you must do to earn your evaluation.

pages.title: Labubu Doll Mukbang Asmr Unblocked
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Labubu Doll Mukbang Asmr Unblocked places you in a bakery serving diners with different bread requests. Prepare and pack orders such as croissants and baguettes, getting each customer's selection ready on time. Click or tap through the food preparation and service activities.

pages.title: Princess Rescue Fruit Connect
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Princess Rescue Fruit Connect asks you to clear boards of fruit to advance a princess rescue. Connect two identical fruits to remove the pair, then find another available match. Finish each layout before its timer expires to continue through the puzzle levels.

pages.title: 2 Player Online Chess
pages.creator: Skilli
pages.description: 2 Player Online Chess lets you play chess against the computer or face a friend in two player mode. Move pieces across the board and plan your attacks while protecting your king. Use the mouse or touch controls to select and move pieces.

pages.title: Color Mix - Jelly Merge
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Color Mix - Jelly Merge challenges you to collect jellies of the same color and clear them from play. Build larger combinations to earn greater rewards as the puzzles become harder. Bonuses can help when you encounter a difficult arrangement.

pages.title: Parking Fury 3D: Beach City 2
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Parking Fury 3D: Beach City 2 combines parking missions with driving around a coastal town. Follow the minimap toward each destination and switch cars when needed. Be careful when taking another vehicle, because police catching you stealing ends the game.

pages.title: Bouncy Blob Race: Obstacle Course
pages.creator: 8Great Games, LLC
pages.description: Bouncy Blob Race: Obstacle Course has you propel a blob toward the finish using thrusts. Each click sends it in the opposite direction of the applied force, so judge your timing and angle around obstacles. Collect powerups and try to beat your opponent.

pages.title: Match Find 3D
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Match Find 3D asks you to locate and collect three identical objects from a crowded scene. Meet each level's collection goals before the clock expires. Keep an eye on the collecting bar, since filling it without clearing matches causes the attempt to fail.

pages.title: The Bodyguard
pages.creator: DarkPlay
pages.description: The Bodyguard puts you between a threatened boss and incoming danger. Move, crouch, and jump to place your own body in the way of attacks. Different jump actions and a time slowing control help you reach the position needed to protect the boss.

pages.title: Stellar Style Spectacle Fashion
pages.creator: CGSpot
pages.description: Stellar Style Spectacle Fashion lets you prepare four friends for a futuristic red carpet event. Choose holographic gowns, metallic accessories, unusual hairstyles, and glowing makeup from their wardrobes. Combine the available pieces into a different space inspired look for each friend.

pages.title: Sunny Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Sunny Link presents summer themed tiles to clear in matching pairs. Two identical tiles can be removed when a connecting route uses no more than three straight lines. Find accessible partners and work through the layouts while seaside sounds accompany the puzzles.

pages.title: Fury of the Steampunk Princess
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Fury of the Steampunk Princess lets you style a heroine for a future shaped by catastrophe and steam technology. Combine clothing such as armored corsets with mechanical accessories to create her look. Save the finished styling as a PNG image if you wish.

pages.title: Jump In To The Plane
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description: Jump In To The Plane challenges you to launch a car far enough to catch an aircraft. Use the mouse to start the attempt and control its boost, judging the flight across different locations. Try alternative vehicles while working toward a successful airborne arrival.

pages.title: Seat Jam 3D
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Seat Jam 3D asks you to move passengers into their correct seats. Select a passenger, then choose the destination while accounting for the space available to move. Passengers travel horizontally or vertically, so diagonal shortcuts cannot solve the crowded arrangements.

pages.title: Racing Island
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Racing Island offers vehicles to drive in racing, freeride, and stand modes. Explore the island and test your control as new vehicles and challenges become available. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer and brake, with Shift activating nitro.

pages.title: Bullet - Superhero
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Bullet - Superhero turns shooting into a ricochet puzzle. Time your shot while the hero's arm keeps moving, and use rebounds to reach enemies around the level. Eliminate every opponent to complete the mission and continue through the stages.

pages.title: Pixel Christmas
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Pixel Christmas fills the board with falling gift shaped blocks. Adjust each package's orientation and position to complete horizontal lines, clearing space for the next arrivals. Keep arranging the presents efficiently to increase your score and prevent the board from filling.

pages.title: Idle Medieval Kingdom
pages.creator: Andy Games
pages.description: Idle Medieval Kingdom lets you develop a small settlement into a kingdom with an army. Construct buildings, manage resources, and research technologies to strengthen your domain. Build up your forces and expand into new lands as your kingdom grows.

pages.title: Pacific Ocean Adventure
pages.creator: hexapp
pages.description: Pacific Ocean Adventure sends you into the depths to hunt fish and earn gold. Face the sharks that threaten the expedition while looking for your next catch. Keep hunting through the underwater environment to gather more earnings.

pages.title: Triple Match Car Master
pages.creator: Globiz.Systems
pages.description: Triple Match Car Master asks you to collect three identical cars into a limited set of slots. Select vehicles from the scene and complete matching triples to clear them. Plan your selections around the available spaces so unmatched cars do not block your next move.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Search
pages.creator: Merson
pages.description: Skibidi Toilet Search asks you to draw routes from characters to their matching colored toilets. Keep the paths apart so the characters do not collide and fight. Your pen has limited ink, making a short, carefully planned route important for completing each level.

pages.title: Bobb World
pages.creator: Catom Games
pages.description: Bobb World follows a hungry traveler from planet to planet in search of food. Gather every food item in each stage while jumping around hazards and landing on enemies to defeat them. Clear the stages by feeding Bobb everything he can find.

pages.title: Dangerous ride
pages.creator: IT-Hype
pages.description: Dangerous ride sends your bicycle across a narrow elevated road above a shark pool. Steer carefully toward the finish and avoid slipping off either side. Use the arrow keys, WASD, or the onscreen mouse controls to guide the bike.

pages.title: Idle Merge City
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Idle Merge City lets you grow a city by buying land and placing houses that produce money. Combine two identical houses by dragging one onto the other to create a larger, more profitable building. Reinvest the income in more property and further merges.

pages.title: Battles of Seas
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Battles of Seas puts you aboard a ship trading cannon fire with opponents. Aim with the mouse or touch controls and launch shots to sink enemy vessels. Collect coins to improve your ship, guns, and ammunition as additional equipment becomes available.

pages.title: Clone Ball Maze 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Clone Ball Maze 3D asks you to deliver as many balls as possible into a green hopper. Guide them through a maze and choose numbered gates that multiply the group. Picking the route changes how many balls can reach the goal.

pages.title: Hoops Champ 3D
pages.creator: Axios Games
pages.description: Hoops Champ 3D offers a sequence of basketball shooting challenges in different locations. Swipe to send the ball toward the basket and judge each attempt. Work through the levels by getting your shots into the hoops.

pages.title: Steve Red Dark
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Steve Red Dark sends Steve toward a green chest through a dangerous dark world. Jump past ground slimes, flying monsters, and arrows from zombies along the way. Press W to jump, use a second jump when needed, and press A to stop.

pages.title: SuperHeroes Puzzle
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: SuperHeroes Puzzle hides superhero icons for you to uncover in matching pairs. Reveal two at a time and remember where the different pictures appear. Clear the board within the time allowance, using fewer moves to earn a stronger score.

pages.title: Survival 456 But It Impostor
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: Survival 456 But It Impostor combines crewmate characters with elimination challenges. In the red and green light test, run while the doll counts and stop when it turns around. Other activities include glass bridge crossings, candy cutting, tug of war, and marble challenges.

pages.title: Pixel Bubbleman.io
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pixel Bubbleman.io drops you into streets where bubble characters fight on contact. Slide to move around, select an opponent, and defeat rivals to gain more survival time. Choose your battles carefully, because an unfavorable encounter can end your attempt.

pages.title: Kobra vs Blocks
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Kobra vs Blocks has you steer a growing snake through numbered barriers. Collect items to increase its size, then choose blocks with values below the length you have built. Survive the crossings and gather more pickups to push your score higher.

pages.title: Disk Area
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Disk Area challenges you to send a disk into a marked target zone. Apply enough power to reach the area without overshooting it. Each successful attempt moves the target, so you need to judge the force again for the next shot.

pages.title: Stickman Archer Adventure
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Archer Adventure puts your bow skills to use rescuing victims of an executioner. Aim and shoot arrows to free the hanging stick figures before they die. Work out each shot through the level's arrangement of ropes and obstacles.

pages.title: Ear Clinic
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Ear Clinic puts you in charge of clearing wax from patients' ears. Choose and use grabbing tools to remove the buildup from inside each canal. Work carefully around the delicate surfaces while cleaning the affected areas.

pages.title: One Point
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: One Point challenges you to time a shot toward a white dot while the aiming arrow moves. Launch when the direction lines up with your target, then repeat the process as new dots appear. Each successful hit adds to your score.

pages.title: High Shoes
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: High Shoes has you run on stilts while trying to make them taller. Guide the runner along the course and keep away from obstacles that threaten your progress. Build up the stilts as much as possible and see how far you can travel.

pages.title: EVO City Driving
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: EVO City Driving gives you a selection of sports cars and a city to explore. Drive through the streets and try out the different vehicles on the roads. Use WASD to steer, Space to brake, and C to change the camera view.

pages.title: Tower Stack Slip
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Tower Stack Slip asks you to guide a character through rows of colored bricks. Collect pieces matching your character's color to build a taller stack. Touching a different color reduces the tower, so steer carefully to finish with a higher score.

pages.title: Mortal Cage Fighter
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Mortal Cage Fighter pits your chosen character against opponents in street fights decided over three rounds. Punch, kick, and jump to attack, or move backward to block. Fill the power bar to use your fighter's special ability and aim to win two rounds.

pages.title: Pop Pop Candies
pages.creator: b10b
pages.description: Pop Pop Candies has you shoot candy into groups of three or more matching pieces. Clear every candy to finish the board before time expires or the formation reaches the bottom. Faster completion earns more stars across its puzzle and endurance challenges.

pages.title: Draw Master 3D
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Draw Master 3D asks you to sketch the missing part of a scene to make something happen. Examine the objects and characters, work out what is incomplete, and draw a solution with the mouse. Each puzzle presents another situation to finish.

pages.title: Happy Wedding Dressup
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Happy Wedding Dressup lets you help Eliza choose her look for a winter wedding. Browse the bridal clothing and put together the outfit she will wear on her special day. Try different dress choices to create your preferred wedding style.

pages.title: Mia Crazy Sunglasses
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Mia Crazy Sunglasses lets you help design an unusual pair of sunglasses for Mia's summer trip. Visit Bella's workshop and select the available design options with the mouse. Combine the choices to finish a pair with its own distinctive appearance.

pages.title: Parking Jam
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Parking Jam challenges you to clear a vehicle's route to the exit through a crowded parking area. Drag cars and trucks forward or backward to move them out of the way. Plan the sequence so the vehicle you need can get through.

pages.title: Creepy Creatures Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Creepy Creatures Match 3 asks you to form groups of at least three matching colored pieces. Keep making combinations to build your score while watching the gauge on the left. Letting that meter fall too low ends the game.

pages.title: Helicopter Taxi Tourist Transport
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: Helicopter Taxi Tourist Transport turns passenger service into an aerial job. Pilot a helicopter around the city, navigate toward pickups, and take travelers to their destinations. Use the map to plan each trip while exploring the urban airspace.

pages.title: Zombie Virus Killer
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Zombie Virus Killer has you tap the approaching zombies to destroy them. Pick out each undead target and click or touch it to attack. Continue eliminating the zombies as they appear in the scene.

pages.title: live line
pages.creator: Roman Parada
pages.description: live line lets you draw a route for a moving line of ink. Find a trajectory that pops every colored ball while keeping away from the black ones. Use rebounds from the side walls when a direct route will not reach the targets.

pages.title: Winter Monster Truck
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Winter Monster Truck offers a series of driving levels set in winter scenery. Choose a monster truck and guide it along the courses, using W and S to accelerate or brake. A and D adjust the vehicle's pitch as you drive.

pages.title: Hit The Sack
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Hit The Sack helps Mia and Bella get ready for bed after a busy day. Remove their makeup and freshen them up before selecting sleepwear for each sister. Use the mouse to complete their evening preparations and choose their bedtime looks.

pages.title: Princess at the Villains Party
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess at the Villains Party asks you to dress princesses for a party inspired by fairytale enemies. Combine dark clothing, witch costumes, demonic details, and other villainous styling choices. Give the normally cheerful characters a spooky appearance for their costume gathering.

pages.title: Pixel Jet Fighter
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pixel Jet Fighter puts your plane against helicopters, aircraft, and ships on the way to an enemy base. Move with the mouse to dodge incoming fire while destroying opponents and their projectiles. Fight through the defenses to reach the main target.

pages.title: Classics Car Stunts 2020
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Classics Car Stunts 2020 puts you behind the wheel of a Jeep on stunt courses high above the ground. Use WASD to control the vehicle as you follow the route. Guide the Jeep through the elevated driving challenges.

pages.title: 2048 Balls
pages.creator: Active Games
pages.description: 2048 Balls has you drop numbered balls so matching values merge into larger ones. Choose where to release each ball and combine equal numbers toward the 2048 target. Use the mouse or touch controls to position the drops.

pages.title: Save The Santa
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Save The Santa asks you to keep Santa clear of asteroids falling from space. Move left and right with the arrow keys or A and D to dodge their paths. Help him survive the impacts threatening his gift delivery.

pages.title: Capital City Cars Match 3
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Capital City Cars Match 3 uses car themed pieces for a timed matching challenge. Arrange at least three matching colored pieces in a row to score points. Keep making matches so the gauge on the left does not fall low enough to end the game.

pages.title: Knife Hit 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Knife Hit 3D asks you to throw enough knives into a wooden target to break it. Click to launch each blade, taking care not to strike knives already embedded in the wood. Shattering the target lets you continue to the next level.

pages.title: Motocross Beach Game: Bike Stunt Racing
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Motocross Beach Game: Bike Stunt Racing combines motorcycle stunts with timed checkpoint courses. Ride across beaches and roads, perform jumps, and reach the required checkpoints before time runs out. Different maps and modes offer more places to test your bike control.

pages.title: InsectAttack
pages.creator: Nela´s games
pages.description: InsectAttack puts you in charge of protecting a cyclist from insects flying into the rider's path. Click or touch the approaching bugs to stop them before they make contact. Keep watching the route and block each new threat.

pages.title: Perfect Wedding Cake
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Perfect Wedding Cake lets you design a cake for a wedding celebration. Choose from the cake options and decorations to build the appearance you want. Combine the available embellishments into a finished design for the occasion.

pages.title: Geometry Jump Bit by Bit
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Geometry Jump Bit by Bit has you jump a geometric character through obstacle courses at a speed you choose. Select a section and adjust the pace from a slow practice setting to faster play. Time your jumps to clear the hazards along the route.

pages.title: Aladdin
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Aladdin follows the hero through a platform adventure with obstacles and enemies along the way. Run and jump through the areas while making use of his weapons against threats. The arrow keys control movement and jumping during the journey.

pages.title: Super Girl Story
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Super Girl Story puts you in the role of a young assistant at a Manhattan fashion agency. Choose responses that shape her relationships and the direction of the story. Follow the romance and uncover the conspiracy connected to her emerging super girl identity.

pages.title: Car Salon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Car Salon gives you several dirty cars to wash. Use the mouse to work through the cleaning activities and restore each vehicle's appearance. Finish one car, then choose another to take through the salon.

pages.title: Horse Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Horse Coloring Book lets you choose a horse picture and paint it with the colors you prefer. Pick a color for the brush and apply it to the image. Keep changing colors to create your own version of the selected horse scene.

pages.title: Cookie Blast Mania
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Cookie Blast Mania challenges you to swap cookies into matching groups and complete each board's targets. Keep track of the moves remaining as you collect the required pieces. Bombs and other boosters provide ways to clear larger sections when the arrangement gets difficult.

pages.title: Helicopter Master
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Helicopter Master combines helicopter combat with rescue missions. Pilot through enemy attacks, destroy hostile forces, and pick up people who need help. Collect coins along the route and work toward the mission's rescue and combat objectives.

pages.title: Color Slope
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Color Slope sends a ball along a curving uphill course filled with colored balls. Steer toward ones that match your current color while keeping clear of incompatible contacts. Use A and D or the arrow keys to adjust your path.

pages.title: Jewel Christmas
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Jewel Christmas turns festive decorations into a matching puzzle. Combine at least three identical pieces to make them burst and clear space on the board. Form larger matches to set off chain reactions and increase the amount you remove.

pages.title: Basketball Machine Gun
pages.creator: Bubito
pages.description: Basketball Machine Gun challenges you to score as many baskets as possible before the time runs out. Aim the ball launcher and send shots toward the hoops. Adjust your attempts to keep putting balls through the baskets during the round.

pages.title: Leave Me Alone
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Leave Me Alone has you defend a martial arts guru from zombies approaching from several directions. Swipe or use the arrow keys to respond to the attackers. Survive the increasingly difficult waves and earn points to unlock characters such as ninjas, samurai, and robots.

pages.title: Plumber & Pipes
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Plumber & Pipes asks you to reconnect broken water systems by rotating pipe sections. Build a continuous route from the source to the required destination, accounting for valves along the way. Work out how the individual pieces must face to restore the flow.

pages.title: Matchems
pages.creator: Saryn Studios
pages.description: Matchems is a memory game built around finding matching pairs. Reveal the hidden pictures and remember their positions so you can locate each partner. Keep pairing the images until the remaining cards have been cleared.

pages.title: Drop Kick World Champs
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Drop Kick World Champs lets you choose a national soccer team and try to win the tournament with accurate volleys. Time your strikes to turn incoming balls into goals. Keep scoring to lead your squad toward the World Cup trophy.

pages.title: Coloring Books: Animals
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Coloring Books: Animals offers six animal pictures and a palette of 24 colors. Select a pencil and move the mouse over the page to color it. Combine different shades to finish the chosen animal illustration in your own style.

pages.title: Animal Olympics - Triple Jump
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Animal Olympics - Triple Jump puts you in control of a kiwi attempting the longest legal jump. Alternate Left and Right to build running speed, then hold and release Up to set the jumping angle. You have three attempts to record your best distance.

pages.title: Wheely 3
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Wheely 3 has you help a small car progress through environments blocked by machinery and other obstacles. Click Wheely and the objects around him to operate devices and solve puzzles. Work out the right sequence to get past bridges, lasers, and barriers.

pages.title: Catchy Bouncy
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Catchy Bouncy combines pachinko style bouncing with a magician's carnival presentation. Send the ball through the objects to gather points, then aim for valuable scoring areas below. Different landing zones apply multipliers, with the hat offering the largest bonus.

pages.title: Hitchhiker's Guide for Princesses
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Hitchhiker's Guide for Princesses follows Ariel and Eric as they prepare for a road trip. Choose a destination, pack six items of different types, and select Ariel's travel outfit. Finish getting ready before helping the couple flag down a passing car.

pages.title: Fruit Connect 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fruit Connect 2 challenges you to clear a board by connecting identical fruits in pairs. Find two matching pictures and select them to remove the pair. Continue locating available partners among the remaining fruit tiles.

pages.title: Barbara Shopping Day
pages.creator: Daria Games
pages.description: Barbara Shopping Day takes you to the mall to prepare Barbara for an event. Try on dresses, then select heels, a purse, and jewelry to complete the outfit. Compare the available combinations and choose the look she will wear.
